How it happens, in words. No pictures yet.

He just loses on The Dating Game.

In George Clooney's directorial debut, Pitt and Matt Damon sit on stools in period wigs and loud 1970s outfits as two contestants on Chuck Barris's The Dating Game. The bachelorette ignores them entirely, and neither gets a line; the joke restages the real-life fact that Burt Reynolds and Tom Selleck went unpicked on the show. Pitt's screen time is a few seconds, and he simply isn't chosen.

Blink-and-miss-it cameo done as a favor to Clooney. No peril of any kind.
